title: 電気材料
subtitle: Electrical Materials
keywords: Structure of atoms and substances 2.Conductive materials 3.Insulating materials 4.Magnetic materials 5.Online/ On-demand class
educationalGoal: The learning and educational goal is to acquire basic knowledge about electrical energy and control technology and the materials and devices that support it, and to be able to utilize them concretely. Understand the functions of electrical materials based on learning basic subjects such as electromagnetism and electrical circuits. Understand how it is applied to electrical equipment studied in specialized subjects.(Related learning and educational goals: L)
advice: In this class, students will study the following items. 1. Atomic structure / substance structure -Atomic structure, atomic bond and substance structure 2. Conductive materials Electric conduction phenomenon of substance, various conductive materials, various electric wires, resistance materials, superconducting materials 3. Insulating materials / dielectric materials Dielectric characteristic of insulating material, dielectric breakdown and electric conduction of insulating material, various insulating materials, ferroelectric materials 4. Magnetic materials Magnetic phenomena and properties of magnetic materials, high permeability materials, permanent magnet materials, magnetic recording materials 5. Regional collaboration Know the materials used in nearby power transmission and distribution facilities. If necessary, learning may take place using digital methods such as online (distance) or on-demand classes.
books: Yasuo Sekii, "Electric Materials", Maruzen publishing company(2001)
requiredKnowledge: Review "Electronics" and "Electromagnetics I" when taking this course. Also, because the scope of study of this subject is very broad. It is essential to review.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the structure of atoms, the bond of atoms and the structure of matter.
Be able to indicate the types of conductive materials, their features and their applications.
Be able to explain the dielectric properties and the phenomenon of electrical conduction in high electric fields
Be able to indicates types of insulating materials, their features and applications.
Be able to explain the magnetic properties of the substance.
Be able to indicate the types of magnetic materials, and explain their features and applications.
